Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-polish-medium-0014", "row_sha256": "0b6e1c508fc71dcdbfba86566d3f28701435510a65bc76d5723273fcdd78cf75", "mode": "/polish", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Rewrite awkward phrasing into readable prose for the supplied profile, or plain prose when none is supplied. Preserve intent and certainty. Do not add a greeting, subject, signature, conclusion, or fact that the input did not supply.", "input": "for the east hall chess club, registration for the saturday rapid tournament is being put together for april 18, with the table opening at 8:15 and the first round listed for 9:00. there are two sections, open and under 1600, and each player needs to mark the section on the paper form along with their name and club. we are wanting the form to have a place for an email address too, but that part is optional, not something a player has to fill in before being registered. the entry fee is $18 per player, and the desk volunteers can accept cash or a check when they take the form. do not charge accounts for entry fees, including when someone says they usually pay club expenses that way. the registration notes should say that a player can ask a volunteer to check the spelling of their name before turning in the form. if a player arrives before the table opens, they can wait beside the posted section list rather than putting a form on the desk. we are using paper forms at this event, so there is no online sign-up step in this plan. the two times should stay distinct: 8:15 is when registration opens and 9:00 is when round one begins.", "output": "The East Hall Chess Club is preparing registration for its Saturday rapid tournament on April 18. The table opens at 8:15, and the first round begins at 9:00. There are two sections, Open and Under 1600. Each player should mark their section on the paper form, along with their name and club. The form should also have a space for an email address, but providing one is optional and not required for registration.

The entry fee is $18 per player. Desk volunteers can accept cash or a check when they collect the form. Do not charge accounts for entry fees, including when someone says they usually pay club expenses that way. A player may ask a volunteer to check the spelling of their name before handing in the form. Anyone who arrives before the table opens can wait beside the posted section list rather than leave a form on the desk.

This event uses paper forms, with no online sign-up step. Keep the times distinct: registration opens at 8:15, and round one begins at 9:00."}]
